items.title: FRC 247 and FRC 445 Looking for Mentors
items.summary: Hello Chief Delphi community! My name is Kevin Traute, and I’m the Assistant Coach for FRC Team 247, Da Bears and FRC Team 445 Da Cubs, based out of Berkley, Michigan. As we prepare for the 2026–2027 season, we’re looking to expand our mentor base by bringing on dedicated, long-term business mentors to support our growing robotics program.
